# TiroAgents

> A pixel office for your own Claude Code agents. Tiro, an orange cube-crab office manager, plans work and asks before it hires specialist agents. The office itself spends no tokens. Version 2.1.0 for Windows, macOS and Linux (named Agent Office before 2.0). Builds are not code-signed. Open source, Apache-2.0.

## Start

- [Quickstart](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/quickstart.html): install and finish a first task
- [Download](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/download.html): files for every system, SHA-256 and install warnings
- [Changelog](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/changelog.html): what changed in each version

## Docs (Markdown copies)

### Get started

- [Requirements](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/requirements.md): What you need before installing TiroAgents: a supported system and Claude Code, signed in.
- [Install and verify](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/install.md): Install TiroAgents on Windows, macOS or Linux and check the download.
- [First task with Tiro](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/first-task.md): Open the office and give Tiro its first goal, then approve the hire and read the report.
- [Update](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/update.md): Check for and install a new version from the island.
- [Uninstall](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/uninstall.md): Remove the app and decide what to do with your data.

### Using the office

- [The dashboard and the office](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/office.md): The panels, the world, the objects and the agent history.
- [Hiring and approvals](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/approvals.md): The strict hiring gate and Claude Code tool approvals.
- [The team](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/team.md): Tiro's eight specialists, how to rename them, and the SOPs that guide their work.
- [Agents and memory](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/agents-and-memory.md): The team, the hiring gate and per-agent memory and history.
- [Goals, reports and the vault](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/goals-and-reports.md): The Today board, reports with PDF and Excel export, and the memory corkboard.
- [The island, Tiro and the tray](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/island.md): The notch-style overlay, the desktop character, the tray menu and keyboard use.
- [Party and the meeting room](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/party.md): Play together, and talk by voice in the meeting room: what others see and how listen only works.
- [Scheduler](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/scheduler.md): The scheduler station, the job and the inbox feed file.

### Safety

- [Permissions and Claude Code parity](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/permissions.md): TiroAgents runs on your own Claude Code configuration. What is the same, what differs and what reaches you.
- [Security model](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/security.md): How the local server, the windows, installs and approvals are protected.
- [Security Guard](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/security-guard.md): An ask-only safety net for secrets, downloaded scripts and untrusted instructions.
- [Breaker box and subscription guard](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/breaker-box.md): Hard switches, and the guard that stops at your plan limit.

### Reference

- [Configuration](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/configuration.md): Preferences, environment variables, settings files, the scheduler job and the terminal bridge.
- [Troubleshooting](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/troubleshooting.md): Windows install warnings and fixes for common problems with TiroAgents.
- [FAQ](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/faq.md): Short answers to common questions about TiroAgents: tokens, hiring, your data and installing.
- [API reference](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/api.md): The local HTTP API that the TiroAgents dashboard and the island use, route by route.
- [Full user guide](https://tiroagents.bmos.website/docs/guide.md): Every panel, the island, the tray, settings files and the API table.
